name: dev-fixtures
description: Development benchmark over the 8 local fixture sites under fixtures/sites. Each entry is served by fixtures/server.ts on 127.0.0.1 for the duration of its scan and uses the tasks declared in its fixture.json ("tasks": "fixture"). The fixture.json "expect" map (check id -> status) and per-task "expect" verdicts are compared against observed results in summary.md. Fully offline and deterministic by design; this is the regression dataset for the checks and the baseline agent, not a claim about real websites.
